posts.text:
Jobs numbers this week were better than expected. So why does the economy feel bad?⁣
⁣
One reason is wage growth the slowest in years. Prices are winning the race. Unless you switch jobs, your paycheck is falling behind. That's the economy people are voting against. https://youtu.be/h0LB9PEiZ3o

posts.text:
US budget deficit this year: ~6% of GDP. Outside of wars or recessions, that's the highest in the postwar era.⁣
⁣
We're borrowing at emergency-level scale with no emergency and no political will to change course. Bond markets have noticed. Voters haven't yet. https://youtu.be/HprbhEwxuT0
